title: Autonomous continuous improvement protocol
human_intent: Make Prometeo safe to improve from page Captures using disposable agents: every worker must load durable global rules, preserve existing work, coordinate concurrent writes, complete the loop, return results into the page thread, and route human-facing links back through the single Universal Host.
already_decided: No competing continuity architecture; extend Agent Runtime v3, P4 Capture, Page Change Threads and existing product authorities.
One Universal Control remains the only global shell; child pages never mount global navigation.
Page-specific continuity lives in Page Change Threads; cross-workstream coordination stays in Runtime/DELTA/RETURN.
Default mutation style is surgical preservation, not clean-slate reconstruction.
A normal request to change something is a delta against authoritative Current, not permission to discard working capability.
Every Prometeo-aware worker must load the mandatory global constitution before material work, then EPOCH + compiled Work Packet + owner/Current/Catalog/Lineage as scoped by the packet.
Only live writing/integrating workers create hard write collisions; historical/completed scope overlap is not a lock.
Human-facing result links route through the Universal Host with page_id + work_item_id; raw child/candidate/served URLs remain evidence or preview targets.
Page Change Feed polls durable execution status, so a worker chat can become irrelevant after launch; the durable RETURN is the result authority.
Change Loop UI owns its contrast variables and uses a translucent overlay instead of inheriting arbitrary child-page palette variables.
known_failures: Do not return a raw child page as the primary human-facing result link.
Do not treat completed recovery workstream scope overlap as a HARD collision.
Do not interpret 'change this' as permission to clean-slate rebuild.
Do not let Change Loop buttons inherit child-page foreground/background tokens.
Do not use chat history as project authority or ask the human to transport recoverable context.
Do not publish private Captures, attachments, tokens or personal payloads into public coordination.
high_value_targets: Mandatory global constitution published and referenced by stable entry/runtime.
Preserve-first and live-write collision semantics encoded in Agent Runtime v3.
PROMETEO EXECUTE hardened with constitution, claim/prewrite/release and durable return laws.
Universal Host page + execution deep links implemented and browser-regression tested.
Change Loop transparency and guaranteed contrast implemented.
Atomic V5 promotion path installed; live GitHub Pages byte verification passed.
execution_frontier: Software frontier complete. Next action is ordinary human product use: record a page-scoped observation, press HACER, ignore the disposable worker chat, then open the resulting Prometeo host link/change indicator and continue from the same page thread. Any failure discovered by that use is a new product bug, not missing architecture from this workstream.
